recommendation: Provide culturally tailored diabetes self-management education and support
implementation_steps: Deliver culturally tailored diabetes self-management education
Support behavior change through motivational interviewing and goal setting
Conduct outreach to patients who miss appointments or have poor control
Connect patients to community and social services
Offer instrumental, informational, and emotional support
evidence_summary: CHW-led culturally tailored diabetes self-management education has been shown to improve glycemic control, self-care behaviors, and quality of life, particularly in underserved and minority populations.
citation: Role of Community Health Workers in Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus Self-Management: A Scoping Review
